tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Fetch a public web page and return its readable content as JSON: plain text or Markdown (headings, lists, links kept), plus title, description, author, publish date, site name, language and preview image. Ads, menus and scripts are stripped. Also reads PDF, Word, Excel and CSV links. Failed fetches

tools.name: read_pages
tools.description: Read up to 5 public web pages or documents (PDF, Word, Excel, CSV) in one call, in parallel. Returns each one's readable text or Markdown plus metadata, and lists any that failed. Charged only if at least one URL was read. Price: $0.006 USDC (x402).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: read_page, read_pages · Private data: read_pages · Public sink: read_page.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: read_page, read_pages · Private data: read_pages · Public sink: read_page

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
